TypeError: Cannot read property 'width' of null
How can I stop this error message??? Because I sorta need this plugin to work lol
I looked up what it is and it's trying to "retrieve an image that doesn't exist" or something....
1 detail to include that seems sorta important is it's only in
the database test battle-
for whatever reason luckily the
normal
battle in the game test mode works without the error

posts.author: Ebon_Maker5
posts.body:
Ok so I'm using -ShoraLighting- and I've noticed something odd, if you have "Battle lighting" on- it makes testing the battles in the database impossible- it only gives the error message:
TypeError Cannot read property 'width' of null
Good news is it's
ONLY
in database, so you can still test it normally with battle lighting on, just not in database... I'm gonna keep it off regardless because that causes no errors, but just thought I'd throw a heads up to anyone with that error- the solution is to turn [battle lighting] off
